description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'BugHonorFileTimeTest' that verifies that the last-modified timestamp of a file added to a ZipStream archive is correctly honored and not overwritten.

classes.name: BugHonorFileTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests whether the ZipStream correctly preserves the file modification time when adding files to an archive.

methods.name: testHonorsFileTime
methods.description: Test method that sets up an archive with a specific file modification time, adds a file, and asserts that the timestamp remains unchanged.
